baseline_models.focus_anchor: The imperative on dh-k-r governs the name of the addressee's Lord, with morning and evening as its two explicit times.
baseline_models.mechanism: Inward retrieval and spoken mention cooperate: the Lord's identifying designation is restored to attention and voiced under the aspect of governing authority. The two daily times make that restoration recurrent rather than occasional.

activation_trace.role: The bringing-to-mind branch supplies the inward retrieval component of the command.
The tongue-borne mention branch supplies the command's outward, repeatable expression.
The name-as-designation branch makes the object an identifying declaration, not an empty sound.
The lordship and authority branch specifies the governing relation made present by the name.
The early-morning branch fixes one recurrent threshold for the act.
The late-day branch fixes the answering threshold toward sunset.

changed_reading.before: Recall or say the divine name in the morning and evening.
changed_reading.after: At the day's two stated thresholds, repeatedly restore the Lord's governing identity to both attention and speech.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The coordinated pair bukratan wa-asila joins the day's first emergence to its established late phase.
baseline_models.mechanism: The first-yield image of b-k-r and the rooted, established image of a-s-l make the pair asymmetrical but complementary. Remembering at emergence and at settlement brackets the daily process, so the command can orient the cycle between the endpoints as well as name two slots within it.

activation_trace.role: The first or earliest yield image casts morning as the day's fresh emergence.
The rooted and established quality image casts the later endpoint as settlement and consolidation.
The literal late-day branch keeps the consolidation image tied to the stated evening time.
Recollection is the operation repeated at the opening and settling boundaries.

changed_reading.before: Perform the same remembrance at two equivalent clock times.
changed_reading.after: Open the day's becoming with remembrance and settle its accumulated course under the same remembered Name.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The split inventory attached to ism includes a visible identifying mark, while Rabb carries staged nurture and completion.
baseline_models.mechanism: On the non-dominant w-s-m branch, naming can be imagined as marking. Repeating the Lord's name at the opening and close places an identifying sign of nurturing governance on the day, making time recognizable as held under that relation.

activation_trace.role: The visible identifying-mark image supplies the exploratory act of marking the day.
The repair, nurture, and completion image identifies what the temporal mark signifies.
Morning supplies the first surface on which the identifying relation is renewed.
Evening supplies the closing surface on which that relation is renewed.

changed_reading.before: The name is merely the verbal object of remembrance.
changed_reading.after: The remembered Name acts as an identifying mark placed on the day's opening and close, declaring whose nurture governs the interval.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah first places the human in a period of not being a mentioned thing, then near its close calls the discourse a reminder. Those two uses load the focus imperative with an existential and textual arc: remembering the Lord's name repeatedly re-situates a contingent, forgetful human inside what makes persons and paths present to awareness.

activation_trace.role: The focus branch supplies active retrieval from absence or forgetfulness.
The nurturing Lord anchor keeps the revised reading relational rather than self-memorializing.
The honorable-mention and repute image gives the opening 'not mentioned' pole social and existential visibility.
The reminder image supplies the near-closing pole that restores a matter and makes response possible.

structural_cues: The same root frames the surah's opening description, the focus imperative, and the near-closing declaration of a reminder.
The focus remains directed to the Lord's name, preventing the human-mentionedness arc from becoming self-celebration.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the movement from 'not mentioned' to reminder; I infer that daily divine remembrance repeatedly locates the human within that movement. A live alternative is that the three root occurrences are related only by ordinary lexical repetition.

changed_reading.before: The command schedules a private devotional recollection.
changed_reading.after: The command repeatedly answers the surah's problem of absence from mention by locating contingent human awareness under the remembered Lord and within an actionable reminder.

context_deltas.mechanism: The path is first gently indicated and later deliberately taken toward the Lord. The focus practice can therefore function as route maintenance: morning remembrance sets direction, and evening remembrance checks or reacquires the same course after the day's movement.

activation_trace.role: Retrieval supplies the repeated reorientation operation.
Morning becomes the initial setting of direction.
Evening becomes the later checking and settling of direction.
Gentle indication toward a road supplies the given orientation.
The extended traversable-road image turns orientation into an ongoing course.
The acquisition and adoption image supplies active uptake of the indicated course.

structural_cues: 76:3 presents the path as divinely shown, while 76:29 presents a path to the Lord as something a person takes.
The repeated relation 'your Lord' in 76:25 and 76:29 keeps the route tied to the focus object.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies indication, a traversable path, and its adoption; I infer that threshold remembrance maintains that adoption through time. The alternative is that remembrance and path-taking are separate responses with no route-maintenance relation.

changed_reading.before: Morning and evening remembrance are stationary observances.
changed_reading.after: Morning and evening remembrance repeatedly sets, checks, and reacquires a lived route toward the Lord.

context_deltas.mechanism: The servants direct feeding toward God while refusing human repayment and thanks; later their effort is itself thanked and recompensed. Against that reversal, naming the Lord morning and evening becomes a discipline of direction before reward: the Name fixes whom action faces without turning remembrance into a demand for return.

activation_trace.role: The designation branch supplies the named pole toward which action is oriented.
Lordship identifies the authoritative recipient rather than a human payer.
The direction and orientation image supplies the action's nonhuman facing.
The will and desire image makes the refusal of return a statement about motive.
The act-for-recompense image supplies the transactional return explicitly refused from recipients.
Acknowledgment of benefit supplies the human thanks that the speakers do not seek.
Recompense returns later from the divine side, sharpening the earlier refusal to extract it from people.
Acknowledgment returns to their striving without having been demanded from beneficiaries.

structural_cues: The declaration of no desired repayment or thanks in 76:9 is reversed by divine recompense and thanked striving in 76:22.
The focus command follows that completed reversal and names the Lord rather than the reward.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies directed action, refused human return, and later divine return; I infer that recurring naming trains the same nontransactional orientation. The alternative is that the motive statement governs feeding only and does not extend to remembrance.

changed_reading.before: Remembering the Name may be heard as a devotional act performed to secure benefit.
changed_reading.after: Remembering the Name repeatedly fixes the direction of action while refusing to make people, praise, or immediate payment its motive.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding prohibition joins refusal of obedience to one who covers truth with the positive command to make the Lord's designation present. Remembering and voicing that Name becomes counter-obedience: it keeps the governing identity visible in attention so rival commands do not become the operative authority.

activation_trace.role: Spoken mention supplies the positive utterance that follows the negative command.
The visible identifying-mark image supplies an attentionally explicit counter-sign.
Lordship supplies the authority maintained against the prohibited rival.
The hiding-of-truth image supplies the obscuring pressure that remembrance counters.
The yielding and obedience image supplies the rival command relation explicitly refused.

structural_cues: A negative imperative in 76:24 is followed directly by the positive imperative in 76:25.
The phrase 'your Lord' carries across the patience command in 76:24 and the naming command in 76:25.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjacent refusal and naming commands; I infer that the positive practice operationally sustains the refusal by controlling salience and authority. A live alternative is that the imperatives are cumulative duties without a replacement mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The verse adds a devotional exercise after an unrelated warning about obedience.
changed_reading.after: The verse gives a recurrent practice of counter-obedience: keep the Lord's identity salient and voiced so concealed truth and rival authority do not govern the day.

context_deltas.mechanism: The Qur'an is emphatically delivered downward as recited discourse just before the commands to endure and remember. The focus then answers received descent with raised designation on the tongue: what arrives as recitation is assimilated into a daily pattern that makes the Lord's name rise in human speech.

activation_trace.role: Tongue-borne mention supplies the human vocal response.
The rising image gives the designation an upward response vector.
The name-as-designation branch keeps the upward image anchored to ism.
Delivery and bringing-down supply the received movement that precedes the focus response.
Reading and recitation identify the delivered material as discourse for vocal uptake.

structural_cues: 76:23 immediately precedes the command sequence of 76:24-26 and intensifies descent with a cognate verbal noun.
The focus combines a speech-capable remembrance root with the name whose dominant inventory includes rising.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies delivered recitation followed by naming; I supply the response arrow from downward delivery to raised utterance. The live alternative is simple chronological adjacency with no vertical reciprocity.

changed_reading.before: The remembrance is an autonomous practice whose content is unspecified.
changed_reading.after: The remembrance is a recurrent human uptake of delivered recitation, answering what descends by raising the Lord's designation in speech.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next ayah extends practice into the night and changes its modes to bodily lowering and prolonged glorification. Morning and evening therefore work as daylight hinges inside a distributed regimen rather than necessarily exhausting the command's temporal reach.

activation_trace.role: Early morning supplies the opening daylight hinge.
Late day supplies the hinge into the night sequence.
Verbal mention supplies the daytime mode that the next ayah complements.
Undertaking an activity at night extends the regimen beyond the two daylight thresholds.
Bodily lowering and submission add an embodied mode to remembered speech.
Declaring transcendence supplies the night's sustained vocal-conceptual mode.
Extended duration prevents the night practice from collapsing into another punctual marker.

structural_cues: 76:25 and 76:26 form one uninterrupted imperative sequence across morning, evening, and night.
The sequence varies act and posture rather than merely repeating one formula.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjacent times and distinct practices; I infer that morning and evening frame a broader distributed regimen rather than limit it. The alternative is a list of separate minimum observances at discrete times.

changed_reading.before: The verse prescribes two brief and self-contained moments of remembrance.
changed_reading.after: The verse supplies the daylight hinges of a wider cycle whose night phase adds embodied submission and prolonged glorification.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate next diagnosis contrasts love of what is hurried forward with abandoning a weighty day behind attention. Placed directly before it, the repeated daily retrieval of the Lord's name becomes temporal training: it interrupts capture by the immediate and repeatedly makes the deferred, consequential horizon present.

activation_trace.role: Retrieval supplies the attentional operation that can restore a neglected horizon.
Morning initiates the recurring resistance to immediate capture.
Evening renews that resistance after the day's immediate demands.
Haste and advancement supply the pull of the immediately available.
Leaving something supplies the active neglect that the practice must reverse.
Putting something behind visibility supplies the attentional concealment of the future day.
Weight opposed to lightness supplies the deferred horizon's consequence and resistance to easy dismissal.

structural_cues: The diagnosis of loving the immediate follows directly after the two-ayah temporal worship sequence.
The neglected heavy day contrasts with the deliberately repeated daily times of the focus.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a temporal regimen followed by a diagnosis of presentism; I infer that the regimen functions as its countermeasure. The alternative is that 76:27 merely contrasts two groups without explaining the preceding practice.

changed_reading.before: Morning and evening are convenient recurring times for devotion.
changed_reading.after: Morning and evening remembrance is an attentional discipline against presentism, repeatedly restoring the consequential horizon that haste pushes out of view.

context_deltas.mechanism: The reminder invites a person to take a path, yet the next ayah nests human willing within divine willing. The focus imperative therefore calls for real, repeated agency without presenting remembrance as self-generated mastery: the servant takes up the practice while naming the Lord whose will contains that uptake.

activation_trace.role: Active recollection preserves a genuine human operation rather than passive fatalism.
Lordship supplies the encompassing authority within which the operation occurs.
Willing directed toward a thing supplies the first, human side of uptake.
The doubled willing construction supplies the containment of human willing by divine willing.
Adoption and acquisition supply the concrete human taking-up that remains required.

structural_cues: 76:29's open invitation is immediately qualified by 76:30's nesting of wills.
The focus command itself combines a second-person imperative with the relational title 'your Lord.'
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies commanded uptake and nested willing; I infer a model of active dependence rather than autonomous technique or passivity. A live alternative is that the will qualification concerns salvation generally and does not characterize the focus practice.

changed_reading.before: Remembering at set times is a self-managed technique under the practitioner's independent control.
changed_reading.after: The practitioner genuinely takes up recurring remembrance, but does so as dependent agency under the Lord whose willing contains every act of willing.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the branch-distant images of a rights instrument and a covenant inside ordinary dhikr and Rabb vocabulary. It remains anchored to two focus roots and to the repeated temporal pair, but downstream prose should present it only as a legal-social analogy for renewed allegiance, not as the lexical meaning of the ayah.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus joins dh-k-r, whose inventory includes a document of right, to Rabb, whose inventory includes a binding covenant, and repeats the act at two daily times.

activation_trace.role: The rights-document image supplies the exploratory form of an attestation that makes a claim inspectable.
The covenant image supplies the binding relation attested by recurring mention.
Morning supplies the first daily renewal point.
Evening supplies the second daily renewal point.

changed_reading.before: The verse calls for recurrent devotional mention.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, each morning and evening mention functions like a renewed attestation of binding allegiance to the Lord.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The material model is surprising because it activates the pulley branch of the focus time noun and coordinates it with the surah's spring, bursting channel, circulation, and watering images. The focus word and every context image are packet-anchored, but no explicit verse says remembrance draws water; downstream prose should label this a cross-domain mechanism rather than an interpretation of bukrah's surface sense.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus's b-k-r inventory includes a rotating pulley, while the named object and vocal dhikr can serve as what is repeatedly brought into circulation.

activation_trace.role: The rotating-pulley image supplies a cyclical drawing mechanism anchored to the focus time word.
The designation image supplies the named source around which the cycle is organized.
Repeated utterance supplies the human motion that keeps the exploratory cycle turning.
The flowing-water source image supplies what can be drawn into an ongoing channel.
Wide splitting and outburst supply the opening of flow.
Circling around a center reinforces the repeated rotational mechanism.
A portion and channel of watering supplies the directed distribution produced by the cycle.

changed_reading.before: Morning and evening are two static points at which a formula is repeated.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the two turns work like a daily pulley cycle that draws from a named source and channels remembrance through lived time.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it lets the q-r-r inventory move between glass vessel and morning-evening images, then lets precise measure turn the focus pair into a temporal container. The analogy remains anchored to the focus times and packet branches, but it is branch-distant from qawarir's immediate vessel sense and should be rendered as a formal material analogy, not a claim that the verse calls time glass.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus explicitly supplies morning and evening as a bounded pair capable of containing a repeated act of mention.

activation_trace.role: Morning supplies one rim of the proposed temporal container.
Evening supplies the answering rim of the proposed temporal container.
Spoken mention supplies what the bounded interval holds and distributes.
The glass-vessel image supplies transparent containment.
The same inventory's morning-and-evening image bridges the vessel material to the focus temporal pair.
Fitting something to its measure supplies the calibrated capacity of the temporal vessel.

changed_reading.before: The two times merely locate the act on a schedule.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, morning and evening form a measured temporal vessel that gives recurring mention a stable capacity and shape.

strongest_changes: The adjacent night command turns the two focus times into daylight hinges within a wider, multimodal regimen.
The following contrast with the immediate and the heavy deferred day makes recurring remembrance an attentional discipline against presentism.
The preceding refusal of obedience makes naming the Lord a positive mechanism of counter-obedience, not an unrelated devotional addition.
The surah-wide dh-k-r arc revises private recall into repeated location within a movement from unmentionedness to actionable reminder.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet made the short command behave as a temporal control point: exact root repetitions linked it to mentionedness and reminder, adjacent imperatives expanded its duration and political force, and split or cross-domain branches exposed live marking, covenant, pulley, and vessel analogies without requiring them to collapse into one reading.
remaining_uncertainties: The morning-evening pair may frame the whole daily interval, or it may prescribe only two discrete observances.
Several strong functional arrows come from adjacency and sequence rather than an explicit causal connective.
The visible-mark baseline and all three outliers depend on non-dominant or branch-distant images and therefore require explicit qualification.
The focus branches support both inward recall and vocal mention, but the ayah alone does not settle whether both modalities are always jointly required.
